items.text: Saquon Barkley stinger, played through after missing most first half with neck roll; MRI today, hope minor. ETR watching.
items.why: Stinger in game vs Titans; returned second half, will MRI.
items.implication: Monitor for Week 3; handcuff elevated if multi-week. Limited touches in game.
items.opportunity: If limited ROS, backups gain carries/red-zone; hope minor keeps RB1 role.

items.text: Jayden Daniels dislocated left elbow, ruled OUT; X-rays negative no fracture, additional testing Monday. Expected to miss time (prior similar ~1 month). Rap: expected miss time.
items.why: Dislocated left elbow on play; carted, ruled out second half. Quinn confirmed.
items.implication: Marcus Mariota in; Commanders offense downgrade, WRs like Diggs/McLaurin impacted short-term.
items.opportunity: Backup QB play; monitor return timeline for ROS.

items.text: Caleb Williams suffered hamstring injury, carted; out of game. ETR watching closely for Week 3.
items.why: Hamstring on scramble; Bears confirmed, carted.
items.implication: Bears QB situation fluid; WRs like Odunze/Moore/Burden impacted short-term.
items.opportunity: Backup QB snaps; monitor severity for ROS rankings.

items.text: Ladd McConkey is officially ACTIVE after cracked rib GTD with optimism and flak jacket plans; Schefter confirmed. Played through prior uncertainty.
items.why: Optimism from reports, Rap bullish tone, limited practice progress; Schefter/Berry confirm active.
items.implication: Start with docks possible; primary WR target share intact vs Raiders.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets expected if no setback; flak jacket may limit some physicality.

items.text: RJ Harvey inactive (hamstring); not expected per ETR. Grab handcuff Jonah Coleman for role look.
items.why: Hamstring; ETR/Levitan projected look for Coleman.
items.implication: Opens backfield snaps/carries for backups in Broncos offense.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/routes for handcuff; monitor snap share postgame.

items.text: Puka Nacua (hip/groin) true GTD for MNF vs Giants, pre-game decision; Schefter trending wrong direction, more likely out. ETR/Levitan noted true GTD. Whittington doubtful.
items.why: Missed practices Fri/Sat with hip/groin soreness; McVay pre-game decision.
items.implication: If out, Adams primary, more TE/run-heavy; have pivots ready.
items.opportunity: Davante Adams target bump; TEs Ferguson/Parkinson, other WRs elevated if inactive.

items.text: Mike Evans hip injury not believed serious by Shanahan; could have returned in 4th if needed. Demarcus Robinson high ankle sprain. ETR notes not expected serious.
items.implication: Likely available Week 3; minimal ROS impact expected.
items.opportunity: Maintains WR role; Robinson absence may concentrate targets short-term.

items.text: Raiders HC Kubiak on Brock Bowers (knee): 'Close, very close. He looks great.' Missed Week 2 but eyeing imminent return (likely Week 3).
items.why: Limited practice, pregame warmup; coach comments post-Week 2 win.
items.implication: Elite TE1 if active Week 3; Mayer holds value short-term.
items.opportunity: Full TE role/routes/targets upon return in Kubiak offense.

items.text: Chris Olave (hamstring) sounds clean/fine, no real docks; expected/active. Joe Burrow (back) active/expected. Schefter confirmed both active.
items.why: Clean reports, no docks for Olave; Burrow back managed.
items.implication: Full starter roles; Saints/Bengals passing games on.
items.opportunity: Normal routes/targets/red-zone for Olave; Burrow volume intact.

items.text: Zay Flowers OUT (hamstring). Opens opportunity for Bateman and others in Ravens passing game.
items.implication: Target share redistribution; Bateman elevated in early action.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for remaining WRs; red-zone potential shifts.

items.text: Michael Pittman OUT (foot). Levitan expects decent look at Germie Bernard; Berry agrees stash for YAC/McCarthy fit.
items.why: Foot injury; confirmed in ETR summary.
items.implication: Colts WR targets open; Bernard stash candidate.
items.opportunity: Slot/YAC role expansion for backups; monitor target share.

items.text: DeVonta Smith RIDE OR DIE: 27% and 38% target shares first two games; leading all WRs in expected PPR points per model.
items.why: Elite target share early; model leader in expected PPR.
items.implication: Strong start/sit and ROS WR upgrade; trust volume.
items.opportunity: High routes/targets continue; WR1 upside locked.

items.text: Jaxon Smith-Njigba 9/155/3 TDs; fifth WR ever with 8+ catches, 120+ yards, TD in each of first two games. Elite early usage.
items.implication: Locked WR1; start every week, high trade value.
items.opportunity: Dominant target/route/red-zone share in Seahawks offense.

items.text: Dallas Goedert (knee) among Sunday injuries watching; did not return. Eagles TE situation to monitor with Barkley stinger.
items.why: Knee injury in game, did not return.
items.implication: TE depth test; monitor for Week 3 availability.
items.opportunity: If out, other TEs or WRs gain targets in Eagles offense.
